text.tspan: each layer is a Kustomization that dependsOn the one before
No health check on this layer. Neo4j's polar-init waits for the credentials agent,
which is in a later layer that depends on this one: waiting here would never end.
up.nu waits for Neo4j after every layer is applied.
A Job that runs until replaced never completes, and Flux's own Job reader
counts only a completed Job as healthy, so a running agent is waited for through the
Endpoints of its Service. A layer with a Job is applied with force: its pod template is immutable.
jira-observer fails when no Jira is set up: expected.
DESIGNED: as each workload's pod starts, polar-init gets a certificate carrying its declared topics
(p:pub, p:sub, from the issuance floor the render wrote). The broker, cert-issuer and the credentials agent
run on that floor before any policy exists, and every subscribe and publish is decided at the broker.
[a layer has been waiting 15 s on a health check begun under an older spec or revision]
run the same command again: nothing is redone, it waits
[a layer is unhealthy at the timeout]
Afterwards, with no one running anything: Flux checks the repo on an interval,
applies a new commit, prunes what left the repo, and puts back what was edited in the cluster.
A Job is recreated when its pod template changes: a rebuilt image changes the digest it names,
and a changed ConfigMap changes the polar.dev/config-hash fingerprint published with it.

The credentials agent itself has no Service and nothing waits for it separately
